# APA-Rated Strength.
# Sustainable by Design.

The only zero-added-formaldehyde I-Joist manufactured in British Columbia, engineered for
reliability and trusted by builders, designers, and distributors across North America.

[Become a Distributor][9]

## Engineered for Reliability.
## Manufactured for Distribution.

AcuJoist® engineered wood I-Joists are manufactured in British Columbia and supplied across North
America through a network of trusted distributors. Each joist is built to meet stringent APA
performance standards, using a formaldehyde-free adhesive and SPF flanges sourced from responsibly
managed forests.

Tested under the APA PRI-400 and PRI-405 programs, AcuJoist products deliver proven strength,
stability, and consistent quality for a wide range of floor and roof applications. Our manufacturing
process integrates MiTek® software compatibility and supports downstream customization by our
distribution partners.

## Automation That Delivers Consistency

Each joist is crafted to exact specifications using formaldehyde-free adhesives for safer indoor air
and reliable structural results. Our streamlined process ensures consistent performance, optimal
fit, and fewer issues during installation, giving builders confidence in every lift.

## Reliable Delivery Across North America

AcuJoist partners with distributors across diverse markets to ensure dependable, on-time delivery of
engineered I-Joists. Our logistics team supports complex supply schedules and high-volume
fulfillment with precision and consistency. Whether you're stocking for regional demand or
coordinating custom shipments, we’re equipped to deliver the performance and reliability your
customers expect.

[Semi truck with AcuJoists loaded]

## AcuJoist Series Specifications

View by SeriesView by Joist SizeView Allied Products

Explore span ranges, depth options, and structural specs across the full ACJ joist lineup. Choose a
joist by Series or Depth depending on how you build and specify.

ACJ 40 Series

## ACJ 40 Series

**Depths:** 9½″, 11⅞″, 14″, 16″

**Best Use:** General residential construction with environmentally responsible materials.
* Flanges: 2½″ x 1½″ proprietary-grade solid-sawn SPF lumber
* Web: 25/64″ engineered OSB
* Responsibly-sourced and forest certified
* No added urea-formaldehyde resins
* Built for performance and value

[ACJ 40 Series]

### Joist Design Software Support

AcuJoist I-Joists are compatible with leading design platforms trusted by engineers and builders
across North America.

**MiTek® SAPPHIRE™ Supply**

Whole-house EWP estimating, layout, and 3D modeling.

[Learn More →][10]
**iStruct® by Simpson Strong-Tie**

Real-time joist layout, member sizing, and design validation.

[Learn More →][11]

## Quality You Can Measure

Every AcuJoist flange is tension tested in-line for structural integrity prior to I-Joist assembly.
Using CSA and ASTM-verified standards and equipment calibrated by an ISO/IEC accredited third party
independent agency, our QA system stretches each 2x3 and 2x4 flange to as much as 10,999 pounds of
force, ensuring performance you can trust, flange after flange.

Every 2 hours during production, off-line testing is conducted to assess tension, stiffness, and
shear strength. These tests are performed in accordance with ASTM standards, with ultimate loads
reaching 3-4 times the design values.

Left End – Grip & Pull

Right End – Fixed Resistance

## Backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty

AcuJoist I-Joists are manufactured to meet the highest standards for strength, straightness, and
dimensional stability.

Each joist is produced under APA-certified programs (PRI-400 & PRI-405) and is built to perform
consistently throughout the life of the structure in which it’s used. Our formaldehyde-free adhesive
and precision manufacturing help ensure product integrity from plant to project.

All AcuJoist products are supported by a Limited Lifetime Warranty for added confidence throughout
your distribution network. Please see warranty documentation for further info

independent agency, our QA system stretches each 2x3 and 2x4 flange to as much as 10,999 pounds of

shear strength. These tests are performed in accordance with ASTM standards, with ultimate loads

## Partnering With St. Jude


Join us in supporting St. Jude. Someone you know may be receiving help from St. Jude, and your
contributions make a big difference.

[Learn More][89]

We make and deliver building materials for the residential and commercial construction industry. As
a North American producer of [engineered wood products][90], [panels][91], and [lumber][92], our
customers can count on our products to build strong and environmentally friendly structures. Our
[wholesale distribution business][93] delivers a broad product mix ranging from our own wood
products to metal, cement, decking, doors, millwork, and other materials. As a dedicated service
partner, great products are only the beginning; our business is built on relationships.

partner, great products are only the beginning; our business is built on relationships.

# Clubs and Pubs Near Me

## Find Pubs, Clubs and Bars Across Australia

8,000+ Venues • All Australian Cities • Live Status Updates

Want to know what's open right now? Our [real-time pub map][43] updates every 60 seconds so you can
see exactly which venues near you are open at this moment - no more wasted trips to closed pubs.

[ Pubs Open Right Now ][44]
LIVE

## Browse All Pubs, Clubs and Bars Across Australia

Clubs and Pubs Near Me is Australia's most comprehensive pub and bar directory, with 8,000+ venues
across every state and territory. Search by suburb or postcode to find pubs, clubs, bars and
nightclubs near you - with opening hours, photos, customer reviews and directions for every listing.

### Popular Searches

[Pubs in Melbourne][45][Pubs in Sydney][46][Pubs in Brisbane][47][Pubs in Perth][48][Pubs in
Adelaide][49]

Explore pubs and bars across every Australian city and region - from Sydney and Melbourne to
regional towns and coastal spots. Use the filters to narrow by venue type, or browse by state to
discover somewhere new.

Our venue information is regularly updated with current opening hours, contact details and customer
reviews. Each listing includes photos and driving directions so you have everything you need before
you go.

[Find Pubs Near Me][50]

## Search Pubs, Clubs and Bars

Enter a suburb, postcode or venue name to search 8,000+ Australian pubs, clubs and bars.

## Find Local Pubs, Bars and Clubs

#### New South Wales & Victoria

Explore [Sydney's vibrant Rocks district][51] and [Melbourne's best laneway bars][52] - two of
Australia's most iconic pub scenes.

6000+ Total Venues

#### Queensland & Western Australia

Discover [Queensland's beachside bars][53] and traditional [Perth pubs][54] - from tropical
waterfront venues to classic WA locals.

1400+ Total Venues

#### South Australia, NT & Tasmania

Visit [Adelaide's wine bars][55], unique [Darwin venues][56] and historic [Tasmanian pubs][57].

300+ Total Venues

#### Regional Australia

Discover charming country pubs in [Ballarat][58], [Echuca][59] and beyond - regional Australia has
some of the country's most historic and welcoming venues.

300+ Total Venues

## Find the Closest Pub to Me

[ [A searchable map showing the location of clubs and pubs near me open right now] ][60]
Use GPS to find clubs and pubs near your current location, or search by suburb or postcode to find
venues anywhere in Australia. Each result shows opening hours, photos and directions so you can
choose the right venue before you go.
[Open Interactive Map][61]

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How do I find pubs near me?

Click 'Find Pubs Near Me' and allow location access when prompted. The map will use your GPS to show
all pubs, clubs and bars within your chosen radius. You can adjust the search distance from 1km up
to 50km.

### How do I find pubs open right now?

Use our Live Map - click 'Pubs Open Right Now' to see which venues near you are currently open. The
map updates every 60 seconds so you always have accurate open status information.

### Can I search for pubs in regional areas?

Yes - the directory covers venues across all of Australia including regional towns, coastal areas
and rural communities. Enter any town name or postcode to find local venues.

### What is an RSL club?

RSL stands for Returned Services League. RSL clubs are licensed venues originally established to
support Australian war veterans and their families. Today they are open to the general public and
typically offer affordable meals, bars, gaming facilities and function rooms. RSL clubs are found in
cities and towns across Australia and are listed throughout our directory alongside pubs, hotels and
bars. [Find out more about what your local RSL has to offer.][62]

Over the years we have worked on all sizes of projects, from garages to multi-million pound
mixed-use developments and our staff are committed to providing excellent service.

## Crendon Timber Engineering

Established in 1967, our multi-award-winning teams at Crendon Timber Engineering have been at the
forefront of the design, manufacture and supply of bespoke, engineered timber products for close to
60 years.

As a six-time winner of the TTJ Structural Timber Systems Supplier of the Year award, including six
wins in the last seven years, our reputation is built on consistently delivering quality, service,
and innovation recognised by our customers and the wider timber engineering industry.

With 12 design and manufacturing locations throughout England and Wales, we are the largest
manufacturer of Roof Trusses and Posi-Joist metal web joists in the UK. Our teams work closely with
our customers to drive new levels of on-site efficiency, exceptional service and innovative
thinking, helping builders and developers deliver more and better new homes.

Established in 1967, our multi-award-winning teams at Crendon Timber Engineering have been at the
forefront of the design, manufacture and supply of bespoke, engineered timber products for close to
60 years.

As a six-time winner of the TTJ Structural Timber Systems Supplier of the Year award, including six
wins in the last seven years, our reputation is built on consistently delivering quality, service,
and innovation recognised by our customers and the wider timber engineering industry.

With 12 design and manufacturing locations throughout England and Wales, we are the largest
manufacturer of Roof Trusses and Posi-Joist metal web joists in the UK. Our teams work closely with
our customers to drive new levels of on-site efficiency, exceptional service and innovative
thinking, helping builders and developers deliver more and better new homes.

# WHAT WE DO?

Extreme Construction is a recognized industry leader in the rapid erection of high-density, mid-rise
buildings.
As one of the largest steel erectors in the United States — and a bondable NY-NJ MBE-certified
company — we bring decades of proven excellence and reliability.

# Cold Form Stick Framing: The Key to Reducing Building Costs and Increasing Efficiency

At Extreme Construction, we are proud to be leaders in the use of Cold Form Steel (CFS) stick
framing for mid-rise projects. Our unmatched expertise and extensive experience with CFS framing set
us apart from the competition, allowing us to consistently deliver projects ahead of schedule and
under budget—without compromising on quality.

# Why Choose CFS Stick Framing for Your Project?

Cold Form Steel stick framing is an economical, efficient, and highly adaptable construction method.
By utilizing CFS, we ensure that our developments stay on track both financially and timewise. CFS
framing is quick to erect, versatile in any weather condition, and rustproof, making it an ideal
choice for modern construction needs.

[img-9]

# What is Cold Form Steel Stick Framing?

CFS stick framing is a form of light-frame construction using sheet steel components. It is commonly
used for wall studs, floor joists, rafters, and truss members, with the most common profile being
the lipped channel. Other shapes, including “Z,” “C,” tubular, and “hat,” are also employed.

 

# Advantages of Cold Form Steel Stick Framing

 

### Sustainability

CFS is made from recyclable materials, offering an eco-friendly alternative to traditional framing
methods.

### Cost Efficiency

The prefabricated nature of CFS ensures fixed costs, eliminating uncertainties and cost overruns.

### Durability

CFS is non-combustible, pest-resistant (including termites), and rustproof, ensuring long-term
stability.

### Weather Resistance

Offered in 12-18 gauge to suit a range of project needs.

### Multiple Flange Widths

CFS will not shrink or warp, even in extreme weather conditions.

### Strength and Rigidity

Despite being lightweight, CFS offers high strength and rigidity, minimizing material costs and
ensuring structural integrity.

### Flexibility

CFS is adaptable to various floor systems and construction designs.

As the largest installer of Cold Form Steel stick framing on the East Coast, Extreme Construction
has built a reputation for delivering quality projects quickly and cost-effectively. Our vast
experience allows us to leverage the full potential of CFS framing, ensuring that your building
project stays on schedule, on budget, and exceeds your expectations.

Contact us today to learn how we can help you save time and money on your next building project.

# Groupe Lebel

#### One of the leaders among lumber manufacturers in Eastern Canada.
#### Offering quality products since 1956.

[Groupe Lebel]

Groupe Lebel’s mission is to optimize the transformation of wood into sustainable products while
contributing to the development of our community.

Precise quality control, from the tree to the finished product. Indeed, we control all stages of our
production.

A constantly expanding range of products:
* lumber
* treated lumber
* accessories
* I-joists
* wall panelling
* fences and more.

Customer service and terms of sale that take your concerns to heart.

## Our values

[Commited]

### Commited

Contributing to the Group's success with passion, efficiency and pleasure!

[Resilient and flexible]

### Resilient and flexible

Acting quickly, thoughtfully and constructively when we need to adjust to different situations.

[Integrity]

### Integrity

Acting with honesty and transparency with all partners in compliance with Group policies and
procedures.

[Coherent]

### Coherent

Acting in a human and consistent manner while respecting our objectives and commitments

[Respectful]

### Respectful

Acting in harmony with our employees, customers, suppliers and partners as if we were all part of
the same family.

### Our story

[1956][28][1975][29][1980][30][1983][31][1984][32][1991][33][1997][34][2002][35][2004][36][2006][37]
[2008][38][2011][39][2014][40][2017][41][2018][42][2019][43][2021][44][2022][45][2023][46][2024][47]
[First sawmill in Squatec]

1956

## First sawmill in Squatec

Purchase of the first sawmill in Squatec, Témiscouata by company founder Deniso Lebel.   He worked
hard to establish the roots of the family business Groupe Lebel until his retirement in 2001, when
the Groupe Lebel then owned nine plants in four provinces.

[Sawmill in Saint-Joseph de Kamouraska]

1975

## Sawmill in Saint-Joseph de Kamouraska

Purchase of the St-Joseph-de-Kamouraska sawmill from the Ouellet et frères company.

[Fence in Témiscouata-sur-le-Lac]

1980

## Fence in Témiscouata-sur-le-Lac

Purchase of the fence manufacturing factory in Témiscouata-sur-le-Lac (Notre-Dame-du-Lac) from the
Clôtures Bérion company. The company would become Clôtures Témis. The assets were sold in 2003.

[Plant 200 in Témiscouata-sur-le-Lac]

1983

## Plant 200 in Témiscouata-sur-le-Lac

Purchase of “Usine 200”, a factory in Témiscouata-sur-le-Lac (Notre-Dame-du-Lac). At the time, the
factory manufactured plywood, and changed its line of work several times to become a factory of
value-added products.

[Bois Traitel plant in St-Joseph-de-Kamouraska]

1984

## Bois Traitel plant in St-Joseph-de-Kamouraska

Product diversification: construction of the Bois Traitel plant (pressure-treated wood) in
St-Joseph-de-Kamouraska.

[Cap-Chat (QC) and Kedgwick, N.B.]

1991

## Cap-Chat (QC) and Kedgwick, N.B.

Construction of the Cap-Chat sawmill in Gaspésie;  the plant was sold in 2019.  Acquisition of a
sawmill in Kedgwick, N.B. The mill was sold in 2003.

[Scotsburn, N.S.]

1997

## Scotsburn, N.S.

Acquisition of a sawmill in Scotsburn, N.S. The mill was sold in 2003.

[Wood torrefaction in Cacouna]

2002

## Wood torrefaction in Cacouna

Purchase of a factory and installation of a thermal oven (wood torrefaction) in Cacouna. The factory
has transformed over time and specializes in the manufacture of interior wood paneling.
In 2024, transfer of value-added operations from the Cacouna plant to Pohénégamook.


[Frédéric takes the reins of Groupe Lebel Inc.]

2004

## Frédéric takes the reins of Groupe Lebel Inc.

Frédéric takes the reins of Groupe Lebel Inc., and manages the plants of Squatec,
St-Joseph-de-Kamouraska, Notre-Dame-du-Lac, Cap-Chat, Cacouna and Kemptville (Ont.). Groupe Lebel
then had 300 employees.

[Dégelis]

2006

## Dégelis

Purchase of the Dégelis sawmill from Bowater Inc.

[Price]

2008

## Price

Purchase of the Price sawmill from Abitibi-Bowater Inc.

[Vallée des Lacs, Biencourt and Lac-des-Aigles]

2011

## Vallée des Lacs, Biencourt and Lac-des-Aigles

Acquisition of the Vallée des Lacs (Squatec), Biencourt and Lac-des-Aigles sawmills from the Richard
Pelletier et fils company.

# Groupe Lebel

#### One of the leaders among lumber manufacturers in Eastern Canada.
#### Offering quality products since 1956.

[Groupe Lebel]

Groupe Lebel’s mission is to optimize the transformation of wood into sustainable products while
contributing to the development of our community.

Precise quality control, from the tree to the finished product. Indeed, we control all stages of our
production.

A constantly expanding range of products:
* lumber
* treated lumber
* accessories
* I-joists
* wall panelling
* fences and more.

Customer service and terms of sale that take your concerns to heart.

## Our values

[Commited]

### Commited

Contributing to the Group's success with passion, efficiency and pleasure!

[Resilient and flexible]

### Resilient and flexible

Acting quickly, thoughtfully and constructively when we need to adjust to different situations.

[Integrity]

### Integrity

Acting with honesty and transparency with all partners in compliance with Group policies and
procedures.

[Coherent]

### Coherent

Acting in a human and consistent manner while respecting our objectives and commitments

[Respectful]

### Respectful

Acting in harmony with our employees, customers, suppliers and partners as if we were all part of
the same family.

### Our story

[1956][28][1975][29][1980][30][1983][31][1984][32][1991][33][1997][34][2002][35][2004][36][2006][37]
[2008][38][2011][39][2014][40][2017][41][2018][42][2019][43][2021][44][2022][45][2023][46][2024][47]
[First sawmill in Squatec]

1956

## First sawmill in Squatec

Purchase of the first sawmill in Squatec, Témiscouata by company founder Deniso Lebel.   He worked
hard to establish the roots of the family business Groupe Lebel until his retirement in 2001, when
the Groupe Lebel then owned nine plants in four provinces.

[Sawmill in Saint-Joseph de Kamouraska]

1975

## Sawmill in Saint-Joseph de Kamouraska

Purchase of the St-Joseph-de-Kamouraska sawmill from the Ouellet et frères company.

[Fence in Témiscouata-sur-le-Lac]

1980

## Fence in Témiscouata-sur-le-Lac

Purchase of the fence manufacturing factory in Témiscouata-sur-le-Lac (Notre-Dame-du-Lac) from the
Clôtures Bérion company. The company would become Clôtures Témis. The assets were sold in 2003.

[Plant 200 in Témiscouata-sur-le-Lac]

1983

## Plant 200 in Témiscouata-sur-le-Lac

Purchase of “Usine 200”, a factory in Témiscouata-sur-le-Lac (Notre-Dame-du-Lac). At the time, the
factory manufactured plywood, and changed its line of work several times to become a factory of
value-added products.

[Bois Traitel plant in St-Joseph-de-Kamouraska]

1984

## Bois Traitel plant in St-Joseph-de-Kamouraska

Product diversification: construction of the Bois Traitel plant (pressure-treated wood) in
St-Joseph-de-Kamouraska.

[Cap-Chat (QC) and Kedgwick, N.B.]

1991

## Cap-Chat (QC) and Kedgwick, N.B.

Construction of the Cap-Chat sawmill in Gaspésie;  the plant was sold in 2019.  Acquisition of a
sawmill in Kedgwick, N.B. The mill was sold in 2003.

[Scotsburn, N.S.]

1997

## Scotsburn, N.S.

Acquisition of a sawmill in Scotsburn, N.S. The mill was sold in 2003.

[Wood torrefaction in Cacouna]

2002

## Wood torrefaction in Cacouna

Purchase of a factory and installation of a thermal oven (wood torrefaction) in Cacouna. The factory
has transformed over time and specializes in the manufacture of interior wood paneling.
In 2024, transfer of value-added operations from the Cacouna plant to Pohénégamook.


[Frédéric takes the reins of Groupe Lebel Inc.]

2004

## Frédéric takes the reins of Groupe Lebel Inc.

Frédéric takes the reins of Groupe Lebel Inc., and manages the plants of Squatec,
St-Joseph-de-Kamouraska, Notre-Dame-du-Lac, Cap-Chat, Cacouna and Kemptville (Ont.). Groupe Lebel
then had 300 employees.

[Dégelis]

2006

## Dégelis

Purchase of the Dégelis sawmill from Bowater Inc.

[Price]

2008

## Price

Purchase of the Price sawmill from Abitibi-Bowater Inc.

[Vallée des Lacs, Biencourt and Lac-des-Aigles]

2011

## Vallée des Lacs, Biencourt and Lac-des-Aigles

Acquisition of the Vallée des Lacs (Squatec), Biencourt and Lac-des-Aigles sawmills from the Richard
Pelletier et fils company.

[The company expands with Bois Daaquam and Lebel Cambium]

2014

## The company expands with Bois Daaquam and Lebel Cambium

The company expands with Bois Daaquam (a sawmill in St-Just-de-Bretenières) and Lebel Cambium
(treated wood and specialties from Dégelis, Bolton and Caledon).

[Saint-Hilarion]

2017

## Saint-Hilarion

Purchase of the St-Hilarion sawmill belonging to Resolute.

[Daaquam lumber: purchase of the sawmills in St-Pamphile and Masardis ]

2018

## Daaquam lumber: purchase of the sawmills in St-Pamphile and Masardis

The company expands with Daaquam lumber: purchase of the sawmills in St-Pamphile and Masardis
(Maine) belonging to Maibec.
The Masardis plant was sold to J.D. Irving Limited in 2025.

[IB EWP, Pohénégamook]

2019

## IB EWP, Pohénégamook

Product diversification with the manufacturing of joists: purchase of International Beams,
Pohénégamook.

[Nouvelle, Gaspésie]

2021

## Nouvelle, Gaspésie

Purchase of the sawmill in Nouvelle, Gaspésie, owned by Temrex.

[Plaster Rock, N.-B. and Les Bois Lemelin, St-Jean-Port-Joli, QC]

2022

## Plaster Rock, N.-B. and Les Bois Lemelin, St-Jean-Port-Joli, QC

Purchase of a sawmill in Plaster Rock, New Brunswick, from Twin Rivers Paper and purchase of Les
Bois Lemelin, St-Jean-Port-Joli, after having been a Groupe Lebel supplier for many years.

[Lafontaine Lumber, Ste-Perpétue]

2023

## Lafontaine Lumber, Ste-Perpétue

Purchase of the Lafontaine Lumber plant in Ste-Perpétue. This plant now carries out planing and
drying operations.

[Interior wood paneling manufacturing in Pohénégamook]

2024

## Interior wood paneling manufacturing in Pohénégamook

Purchase of a Bastille Portes et fenêtres building in the Sully district of Pohénégamook and
transfer of value-added operations from the Cacouna plant. The plant specializes in the manufacture
of interior wood paneling.

# James Jones & Sons Limited

**World-leading **
I-Joist
production line

James Jones & Sons Ltd is a 5th generation family business and one of the UK’s largest and most
progressive timber processing companies with core activities in timber harvesting, sawmilling,
pallets & packaging, and distribution. We operate from 28 sites across the UK, 3 Australian and 2
New Zealand sites and employ over 2,100 people. In the UK, we operate seven sawmills throughout
Scotland and the north east of England: an engineered wood manufacturing plant in the north of
Scotland and pallet and packaging operations at 14 sites across the UK. We produce high quality,
British grown timber for the UK construction, landscaping, and agricultural sectors; market-leading
JJI-Joists for the housebuilding and construction markets and pallets and packaging for blue chip
domestic and exporting businesses.

[

Our Timber Systems Division was launched over 20 years ago and has grown to become the UK’s largest
manufacturer of FSC® and PEFC certified I-Joists, branded as JJI-Joists. Today JJI-Joists have a 45%
share of the UK's I-Joist market and are used by every major UK housebuilder.

pallet repair division handles 25 million pallets a year.

### COMMUNITY

Το Πάρκο Καινοτομίας JOIST αναδεικνύει την αξία της συνεργασίας και της συνέργειας, μέσα από τη
phygital κοινότητά του. Άτομα, ομάδες, startups και εταιρείες από την Ελλάδα και το εξωτερικό
συνδέονται και συνεργάζονται, εμπνέονται, δημιουργούν λύσεις και αναπτύσσονται μαζί.

Αποκτήστε πρόσβαση σε ευκαιρίες και εργαλεία επιχειρηματικής ανάπτυξης, εκδηλώσεις δικτύωσης και
εκπαιδεύσεις, αυξήστε τη δυναμική σας και απολαύστε αποκλειστικά προνόμια.

Συμμερίζεστε τον τρόπο σκέψης μας;

# Strength comes from within

The future way of building homes has been around for more than 40 years

# Climate-smart

We use 47% less raw material compared with solid structures

# Large spans

Despite its light weight, our I-joist is suitable for large spans

# Extremely quiet

Use our I-joist if you have strict sound insulation requirements

## The future way of building homes has been around for more than 40 years

Masonite Beams is the energy-efficient beam that preserves the Swedish forests. The beam’s I-profile
means that less material is used compared with solid structural timber. In the northen part
tradition, we develop the building systems of the future from the factory in Rundvik. When you
choose Masonite beams you get quality - strong, lightweight beams. The beams we have been
manufacturing for more than 40 years are supplied in flat packs.

[

### Floors

Floors made using Masonite Beams’ I-joist can be installed quickly, while it is also easy to make
holes for installations.

][51]
[

### Walls

Masonite Beams’ I-joist gives you an energy-efficient wall structure with a low U-value and small
thermal bridges. The wall studs are straight and dimensionally stable, which simplifies execution.

][52]
[

### Roofs

Our I-joist is often used for roofs. The I-joist manages large spans with heights up to 500 mm. A
cost-efficient alternative for well-insulated structures.

][53]

"Masonite Beams offer an advantageous way of replacing a solid frame, and at the same time give the
end customer lower energy consumption"

**Tornedalshus AB**

"Masonite Beams guarantee our high quality requirements for straight and made-up beams with short
delivery times"

**Attacus Jämtlandshus AB**

## News from Masonite Beams

[More articles][54]

## Our products 
## WE ADAPT ACCORDING TO YOUR PREFERENCES

Masonite Beams offer pre-fabricated beams that make the building process simpler, reduce waste and
provide high quality in industrial production. Our machines process to 0.2 mm precision. We adapt
the beam according to preferences with, for example, hole cutting, precise and mitre cuts,
reinforcements, eaves rafters, web insulation and filling. We package pre-fabricated beams precisely
and individually and supply fittings adapted to the beam delivery.

#### HOLE CUTTING

We adapt your joist with holes in different sizes and shapes.

#### EAVES RAFTERS

Choose from our eaves rafters in solid wood in various shapes and designs.

#### WEB FILLING/END BLOCKS

We produce web filling/end blocks in wood or particle board.

#### MITRE CUTS

We supply both mitre-cut and straight studs and joists in one or more sections.

#### FITTINGS

We have a wide range of fittings adapted for the I-joist.

#### WEB INSULATION

We also offer web-insulated joists and studs.

#### LIGHT WEIGHT

#### NO SHRINKAGE

#### LARGE SPANS

#### POSIBILITY FOR HOLE CUTTING

#### DIMENSIONALLY STABLE

## Design and installation

A wide choice. You can use Masonite Beams’ products to build detached houses, extensions, apartment
blocks and high-rise buildings. We offer you several ways to reduce your costs. The light weight
makes them easy to handle, increasing the project’s efficiency. A construction worker, for example,
can carry our products, which means that many work processes can be performed before you need a
crane.

[Documentation][55]

## Contact

### Which department do you want to get in touch with?

Feel free to contact us ahead of your next construction project. Then we can make it easier for you
to think sustainable, resource-efficient and effective!

**Postal address: Masonite Beams AB,** **Box 5,** **SE-914 29 Rundvik, Sweden**
**Visiting address: Masonite Beams AB, Strandvägen 36, SE-914 41 Rundvik, Sweden**

Phone (switchboard): +46 (0) 930 - 399 00 
Phone (loading/unloading): +46 (0) 930 - 399 25
Email: [**kundcenter@byggmagroup.se**][56]

Send your order to: [**order@byggmagroup.se**][57]

blocks and high-rise buildings. We offer you several ways to reduce your costs. The light weight
makes them easy to handle, increasing the project’s efficiency. A construction worker, for example,
can carry our products, which means that many work processes can be performed before you need a
crane.

## The open joist **TRIFORCE^{®}** adapts to

## ALL TYPES OF PROJECTS

### SINGLE-FAMILY

The open joist TRIFORCE® helped build hundreds of thousands of single-family homes in both Canada
and the United States. When specified on architectural plans, it facilitates the work of
contractors, carpenters, electricians and plumbers. The open web design and superior performance of
the TRIFORCE® help simplify your life and significantly reduce costs.

### MULTI-FAMILY

TRIFORCE® open joist will meet or surpass your floor framing requirements for Multi-Family housing.
It will provide you with a solid feeling floor system, fire resistance and high levels of durability
and reliability. Because its design draws on the natural strength that comes from its triangular
design, TRIFORCE® is naturally stiffer. Its open web design makes it easy to add strongback bridging
to give it superior strength and produce a solid feeling floor system.

### NON-RESIDENTIAL BUILDINGS

Architects already recommend the open joist TRIFORCE® on several light commercial, industrial and
institutional projects. TRIFORCE® floor system is not afraid of being tested and is designed to
withstand harsh weather conditions and even fire. In addition, it provides support for heavy loads
over long spans. Selecting TRIFORCE® for non-residential buildings means you opt for a product that
gives you the best performing floor system.

The all-wood open web joist

That meets **your needs**

**SAVE TIME** on site
and get peace of mind

Adopt a **HIGH QUALITY** and innovative product

**DISTINGUISH** yourself from competitors

Get a proven and **CERTIFIED PRODUCT**

### A few words from our customers

> [Tri-State Forest Products, Inc.][35]
> Rob Latham, President
> When I first looked at TRIFORCE® I was impressed with the product. Digging deeper, I learned about
> the automation in their manufacture process, the testing of each piece, the on ground inventory,
> the technical support, even the literature. The entire package really gave me confidence that this
> product was something unique. Six years and a lot of hard work later I can honestly say I’ve never
> been disappointed. I have yet to hear a single complaint from the users and in fact discovered
> early on TRIFORCE® is actually firmer under foot then other made-to-order plated floor trusses or
> EWP products.

> [KI-Lumber][36]
> Mike Meehan, Corporate Advisor
> TRIFORCE® has provided a very good solution to many of the problems dealing with floor systems.
> The performance alone has been well received from our builder customers. The convenience of the
> open webs has also proven to be very beneficial. And it also provides a better solution to fire
> code over basement areas. I believe it to be one of the top products we offer.

> [Gradison Design-Build][37]
> Brooks Longfellow, Division Manager
> TRIFORCE® provides an exceptional floor system solution that improves the performance and design
> of the home throughout. From the increased strength and minimized deflection to the ability to
> eliminate bulk heads by running mechanicals through the product, TRIFORCE® has helped us create
> improved spaces for our clients throughout their home and has aided in the elimination of warranty
> issues. One of the most underused products in Homebuilding.

> [Sanford & Hawley, Inc.][38]
> Frank Sanford
> TRIFORCE® joists are a terrific solution for our customers who want the strength and rigidity of
> an engineered floor system while meeting fire codes without the onerous burden of having to
> drywall the entire basement ceiling. Framers love the light weight and workability as well.

> [Compass Homes][39]
> Joe Martin, Designer
> A great solid floor system. No bounce in floors even at max spans. Really makes it easier to run
> plumbing, HVAC lines, and electric.

It will provide you with a solid feeling floor system, fire resistance and high levels of durability
and reliability. Because its design draws on the natural strength that comes from its triangular
design, TRIFORCE® is naturally stiffer. Its open web design makes it easy to add strongback bridging
to give it superior strength and produce a solid feeling floor system.

### NON-RESIDENTIAL BUILDINGS

Architects already recommend the open joist TRIFORCE® on several light commercial, industrial and
institutional projects. TRIFORCE® floor system is not afraid of being tested and is designed to
withstand harsh weather conditions and even fire. In addition, it provides support for heavy loads
over long spans. Selecting TRIFORCE® for non-residential buildings means you opt for a product that
gives you the best performing floor system.

#### PinkWood Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of high-quality wood I-joists, designed for both
#### residential and commercial construction.

With a focus on efficiency and precision, we specialize in the high-volume production of top-tier,
competitively priced I-joists that meet the demands of modern building projects.

Innovation, creativity, and resourcefulness are at the core of everything we do, allowing us to
continually enhance our products and processes.

**Above all, we are committed to total customer satisfaction—driving us to deliver excellence in
every joist we produce.**

[ COMMERCIAL PRODUCTS ][26]
[ LEARN MORE ][27]

#### Our I-joists

We manufacture two types of joists, each designed for a specific purpose:
1. **PKjoist** (Standard Joists)
2. **SAFEjoist** (PKjoist + WEBSHIELD®) – Enhanced, protected joists ideal for use over unfinished
   basements and crawlspaces.

The name "PinkWood Ltd." originates from the pink fire-rated coating we initially applied to our
joists when the company was founded. Today, we continue to apply a signature pink sealer to the ends
of our joists.

#### Our Company

Founded in 2009, PinkWood Ltd. is a privately owned manufacturer of I-joists, with its Head Office
and production facilities located in Calgary, Alberta, Canada.

Driven by a culture of innovation, creativity, and lean manufacturing principles, PinkWood Ltd. has
established itself as one of the most agile joist producers in North America. Our commitment to
total customer satisfaction is at the heart of everything we do, guiding us every day.

#### Engineered Floor System Guarantee

PinkWood Ltd. joists are engineered and manufactured to meet or exceed the stringent standards set
by all major code approval agencies across North America.

We offer an unconditional guarantee that all PinkWood Ltd. joist products are free from
manufacturing defects. When installed and handled according to the PKjoist installation guide, our
joists will perform as per the published structural specifications.

In the rare event that a manufacturing defect is discovered, PinkWood Ltd. will be given a
reasonable opportunity to inspect the product on-site. If the evaluation confirms a defect due to
manufacturing, we will promptly address and resolve the issue.

For specific details and limitations of this guarantee, please contact a representative of PinkWood
Ltd.

#### PinkWood Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of high-quality wood I-joists, designed for both
#### residential and commercial construction.

With a focus on efficiency and precision, we specialize in the high-volume production of top-tier,
competitively priced I-joists that meet the demands of modern building projects.

Innovation, creativity, and resourcefulness are at the core of everything we do, allowing us to
continually enhance our products and processes.

**Above all, we are committed to total customer satisfaction—driving us to deliver excellence in
every joist we produce.**

[ COMMERCIAL PRODUCTS ][26]
[ LEARN MORE ][27]

#### Our I-joists

We manufacture two types of joists, each designed for a specific purpose:
1. **PKjoist** (Standard Joists)
2. **SAFEjoist** (PKjoist + WEBSHIELD®) – Enhanced, protected joists ideal for use over unfinished
   basements and crawlspaces.

The name "PinkWood Ltd." originates from the pink fire-rated coating we initially applied to our
joists when the company was founded. Today, we continue to apply a signature pink sealer to the ends
of our joists.

#### Our Company

Founded in 2009, PinkWood Ltd. is a privately owned manufacturer of I-joists, with its Head Office
and production facilities located in Calgary, Alberta, Canada.

Driven by a culture of innovation, creativity, and lean manufacturing principles, PinkWood Ltd. has
established itself as one of the most agile joist producers in North America. Our commitment to
total customer satisfaction is at the heart of everything we do, guiding us every day.

#### Engineered Floor System Guarantee

PinkWood Ltd. joists are engineered and manufactured to meet or exceed the stringent standards set
by all major code approval agencies across North America.

We offer an unconditional guarantee that all PinkWood Ltd. joist products are free from
manufacturing defects. When installed and handled according to the PKjoist installation guide, our
joists will perform as per the published structural specifications.

In the rare event that a manufacturing defect is discovered, PinkWood Ltd. will be given a
reasonable opportunity to inspect the product on-site. If the evaluation confirms a defect due to
manufacturing, we will promptly address and resolve the issue.

For specific details and limitations of this guarantee, please contact a representative of PinkWood
Ltd.

# Engineered wood products built to order and built for anything.

RedBuilt is the industry leader in custom, sustainable wood building products for commercial
applications. For over 60 years, we’ve collaborated with architects, engineers, and contractors to
bring projects to life with less wasted time and material.

[ OUR PRODUCTS ][61]

## Eliminate Challenges.
## Expedite Timelines.

Decades of expertise and direct-to-jobsite delivery mean your projects happen faster and with fewer
headaches.

## RedBuilt Makes Buildings Better

RedBuilt products make more design options possible, simplify processes, and reduce your project’s
environmental footprint.

[ BUILD WITH US ][62]
[Interior of Maple Valley library]

### Unmatched commercial expertise

You name it, we’ve built it — from restaurants to schools and everywhere in between.

### Fewer supply & design issues

When customizable materials meet an experienced team, everybody wins.

### Greater sustainability & efficiency

Engineered wood makes better use of resources.

### Nationwide distribution

Consistency and efficiency no matter where
you’re breaking ground.

[background image]

## OUR TEAM

From design to manufacturing to installation, the RedBuilt team can help with every step of your
project, no matter where you’re located.

[ MEET THE TEAM ][63]

## Commercial Specializations

RedBuilt products can be utilized in nearly any commercial application — from small to large
projects and from pre-designed prototypes to unique designs like schools and places of worship.
Plus, offsite construction options can offer even quicker timelines and more predictable budgets.

[ SEE HOW WE CAN HELP ][64]
[Diagram showing National Brands, Warehouses, Offices, Education, Retail, High-Density Housing, And
More.]

Schwabe, who will retire later this year after ten years of leadership.

applications. For over 60 years, we’ve collaborated with architects, engineers, and contractors to
bring projects to life with less wasted time and material.

## Eliminate Challenges.
## Expedite Timelines.

headaches.

environmental footprint.

### REPUBLIC TRUSSWERKS

**WHY REPUBLIC TRUSSWERKS?**

Republic Trusswerks, based in Harrisonburg, Virginia, is a leading manufacturer of structural
building components. We specialize in designing and fabricating custom-engineered wood products,
including roof trusses, floor trusses, and I-joists, tailored for residential, agricultural, and
commercial projects. Our roof and floor trusses are engineered to provide structural efficiency and
strength while offering design flexibility to accommodate various construction needs. Additionally,
our I-joists offer greater resistance to deflection, bending, and shear, making them suitable for
both floor and roof framing.

dream homes. We will manage your project through to it’s successful on-time and on-budget delivery.

## Our Core Services in Bangladesh

ASF Corporation offers a full range of Excavation Services and construction services from deep
foundation work to final land grading.

[ASF Corporation – Professional Hydraulic Rotary Bored Piling Company in Dhaka]ASF Corporation –
Trusted Expert in Hydraulic Rotary Bored Piling in Dhaka

## Piling & Foundation Solutions
* ## Cast-In-Situ Piling By Hydraulic Rotary Rig
  
  Reinforced concrete piles made on site for strong, permanent foundation systems.
* ## Pile Lifting & Steel Sheet Pile Driving
  
  Vibration-free sheet pile installation for retaining walls and deep foundations.
* ## Sheet Pile Supply & Installation
  
  Direct supply of rust-proof, high-grade steel sheet piles at competitive prices.
* ## Precast Pile Casting and Driving
  
  Concrete piles made off-site and driven into the ground for a sturdy foundation.
* ## Bolli Supply (Timber Piling)
  
  Engineered wood I-joists driven into the ground for stable, lightweight foundations.
* ## Sand Pile Construction
  
  Cost-effective soil stabilization for flood-prone or weak soil areas.
* ## I-Joist Driving
  
  Engineered wood I-joists driven into the ground for stable, lightweight foundations.

All piling work follows BNBC, IEB, and ACI standards to ensure long-term safety and stability.

[Excavation & Site Preparation - asf corporation]

## Excavation & Earthwork
* ## Foundation & Basement Excavation
  
  Up to 30 meters deep with safe shoring systems.
* ## Deep Excavation & Canal Excavation
  
  For infrastructure, bridges, and drainage improvement.
* ## Topsoil & Earth Excavation
  
  Site cleaning and land cutting for new construction.
* ## Land Grading & Site Preparation
  
  Leveling and compacting soil for a build-ready surface.
* ## Pond Excavation
  
  Rural and commercial pond development for farms and estates.

Our long boom excavators and hydraulic breaker excavators are ready for any challenge, operated by
trained professionals with a strong safety record.

[Demolition and Site Clearing Bangladesh]

## Demolition & Site Clearing
* Bridge Demolition and Complete Building Demolition
* Pile Breaking & Demolition
* Site Clearing & Debris Removal

Our demolition process is controlled, safe, and eco-friendly, using hydraulic breaker excavators for
clean removal and recycling of debris.

Join SJI for the live webinar on Wednesday, August 19, 3:00-4:30 p.m. ET.

[Register For Webinar][29]

### UPDATED | Technical Digest 9 Handling and Erection of Steel Joists and Joist Girders

The latest Technical Digest 9 includes a new chapter on erection engineering, expansions on loading
and shipping joists as well as details on joist products, including special configuration joists and
more.

[Order TD 9][30]

### Floor Bay Comparison Tool – With Vibration

SJI’s design tool helps the SER compare weights, costs, and floor depths for selected bay sizes and
framing setups. It offers composite and non-composite designs for open web steel joists, wide flange
beams, and girders, though only non-composite joist girders are currently available.

[**Download Tool For Free**][31]

## Identify Existing Joists

Need help identifying existing joists in a building structure? SJI will review our extensive files
to find joists similar to those you have located in an older building..

[Identify joists][32]

## Featured Projects

### Seaport Office Building

Commercial, Office

The Class A Office building in Boston, MA was completed in 2018 and features a total of 400,000 sq
ft. The building is a Green Building LEED Certified Platinum featuring 17 floors with retail space
on the 1st and 2nd floors.

[Read More **→**][33]

### Child Care Center

Commercial

The 50,000sf ESPN Child Care Center achieves a minimum LEED Silver Certification with strategies
including use of local, natural materials, appropriate building orientation and lots of daylighting
and views.

[Read More **→**][34]

### Steel & Stainless Steel Process Facility

Industrial, Manufacturing Buildings

One of the most interesting facts of the project was the sheer size. Steel tonnage totals are as
follows: Roof Joists = 1,227 tons; joist girders = 2,668 tons; wall joist = 1,045 tons; and joist
bridging = 540 tons.

[Read More **→**][35]

# 40 Jahre STEICO – 40 Jahre Innovationen

[Nachhaltigkeit]

**Wir lieben Holz!**

Seit 40 Jahren widmen wir unsere ganze Kraft diesem fantastischen Naturprodukt. Holz glänzt durch
Langlebigkeit, Belastbarkeit und Energieeffizienz. In Form von STEICO Holzfaser-Dämmstoffen und
Tragwerksprodukten sind diese positiven Eigenschaften sogar nochmals optimiert. Es freut uns, dass
wir in den vergangenen Jahrzehnten hundertausende Kunden von unseren Produkten begeistern konnten.

**Danke!**

Danke an alle Bauherren, Handwerker, Holzbaubetriebe und Händler für Ihre Treue. Dass STEICO heute
Weltmarktführer* bei Holzfaser-Dämmstoffen ist, verdanken wir ausschließlich Ihnen. Und es ist uns
ein Ansporn, auch in den nächsten 40 Jahren alles zu geben, um unsere Kunden jeden Tag auf's Neue zu
begeistern.

*Basierend auf den Produktionsmengen des Jahres 2025 und eigener Einschätzung. Weitere Information
in den STEICO Geschäftsberichten.

### STEIC0* LVL 35 P*

Das Zukunftsholz. Wie Vollholz - nur leistungsfähiger und kurzfristig verfügbar.

[Mehr][117]

[STEICO safe]

### STEIC0*safe*

Die Holzfaser-Dämmplatte für extra Regensicherheit - mit aufkaschierter Unterspannbahn

[Mehr][118]

### Innendämmung mit STEICO*internal*

NEU: Mit Beschichtungssystem STEICO*interior* auf Kalkbasis

[Mehr][119]

### STEICO*timberfloc*

Die erste Einblasdämmung mit einer Kombination aus Holzfaser UND Zellulose

[Mehr][120]

tapered blocking, sleepers, or built-up ridge assemblies on sloped roof systems. Achieve positive
drainage and precise roof pitch directly from the structural member, engineered to your exact slope
specification.
* Single taper (one sloped cut) — factory-set slope to your exact specification
* Available in all six series - any flange grade, any web thickness
* Eliminates site-cut tapering labor and material waste entirely
* Precise factory slope - no field layout errors or callbacks
* Ideal for low-slope commercial roofs requiring positive drainage
* Reduces overall roof system weight vs. blocking-based alternatives

counteracting anticipated dead load deflection so floors and roofs settle to true level under
service conditions. No field shimming, no callbacks, no long-term deflection complaints.
* Factory camber calculated to offset specified dead load deflection
* Eliminates post-installation shimming and leveling labor entirely
* Ideal for long-span commercial floors with concentrated dead loads
* Improves long-term performance and occupant satisfaction
* Available across all six WEB-i® series on request

★ Premium Option
Tapered I-Joists
Single Taper / Slope · Any Series · Custom Slope

Available across all six WEB-i® series, factory-tapered I-joists eliminate the need for separate
tapered blocking, sleepers, or built-up ridge assemblies on sloped roof systems. Achieve positive
drainage and precise roof pitch directly from the structural member, engineered to your exact slope
specification.
* Single taper (one sloped cut) — factory-set slope to your exact specification
* Available in all six series - any flange grade, any web thickness
* Eliminates site-cut tapering labor and material waste entirely
* Precise factory slope - no field layout errors or callbacks
* Ideal for low-slope commercial roofs requiring positive drainage
* Reduces overall roof system weight vs. blocking-based alternatives

★ Premium Option
Cambered I-Joists
Factory Camber · Dead Load Offset · Project-Specific

WebJoist manufactures I-joists with engineered camber built directly into the member at the factory,
counteracting anticipated dead load deflection so floors and roofs settle to true level under
service conditions. No field shimming, no callbacks, no long-term deflection complaints.
* Factory camber calculated to offset specified dead load deflection
* Eliminates post-installation shimming and leveling labor entirely
* Ideal for long-span commercial floors with concentrated dead loads
* Improves long-term performance and occupant satisfaction
* Available across all six WEB-i® series on request

Factory-Installed Services
Save Time on Site.
Eliminate Waste.

Two premium factory services ordered with your I-joists and delivered ready to install. No cutting.
No drilling. No callbacks. Available on any WEB-i® series.

Precision End Trim

[animated testimonial stars]

**– Liz & Duncan**

There’s a very welcoming feel as you approach the cottage. It feels like a big hug. It’s the perfect
design for what could have been a very difficult lot. Coming down the stairs and looking out at the
view of the lake… it still catches my breath. It doesn’t feel real yet. It feels like someone’s
beautiful Airbnb.

process itself was very in-depth and personal. They explored how we wanted to use the cottage and
how best to design the space for functionality while also maximizing the view. By encouraging us to
think through details, it made the entire process much more efficient.

# J.M. Thomas Forest Products

## Independent wholesale building materials Distributor

[ Our Products ][24]

## Welcome to J.M. Thomas Forest Products!

We are your experts in engineered wood, lumber, panels, siding, pre-finish, and specialty building
products interior and exterior. We understand the needs and trends of the building industry and work
through retail yards to successfully provide quality building materials to the markets we serve.  

[ Contact Us ][25]

## Founded in 1981 by J. Matthew Thomas

### Service, Quality, and Commitment are not just words, but a way of doing business.

[ About Us ][26]

Product Highlight

ADORN STONE
* ADORN Stone sets a new standard in sustainable building. Made from high strength concrete and
  recycled materials, it delivers the authentic look of natural stone with lasting durability.
* It's fastener-based installation eliminates mortar, reducing environmental impact while improving
  efficiency - making it an ideal choice for both contractors and DIYers.
* Mortarless installation means faster, cleaner installation with no mixing mortar or messy
  clean-up.
* The screw-fastened panel system is easy to install using common tools. No clips, wires or starter
  strip required simplifing the installation process and reduces labor and material costs.
* Provides long-lasting durability and resistance to every day exposure.
* Ideal for home exteriors, fireplaces, accent walls, outdoor kitchens, fireplaces, columns, and
  commercial projects.
* Suitable for year round installation and reliable performance in a number of climates.
* Limited Lifetime Warranty provides added confidence in the products long-term quality and
  performance.

### come work with us

[ Apply Now ][40]

## Company Updates & News

### July Industry Outlook - Building Momentum

July is the heart of the building season, bringing long days, busy jobsites, and plenty of
opportunities to transform homes and commercial spaces. From outdoor living areas and exterior
renovations to curb appeal upgrades, summer continues to be the ideal time for projects that make a
lasting impact. Homeowners remain focused on improving the homes they already love, driving strong
demand for remodeling projects, outdoor entertainment spaces, and durable, low-maintenance building
materials. Builders are also embracing innovative products that help save time on the jobsite, while
delivering high-quality results. This month is about making the most of the season. Outdoor living
spaces, kitchens, entryways, and accent walls are among the most popular projects as families
prepare to entertain guests and enjoy time outdoors. Fast-install systems and sustainable building
solutions continue to gain attention as builders look for ways to improve efficiency without
sacrificing style or performance. This July, we should all take the opportunity to celebrate
America's 250th year of freedom and Independence Day reminds us of the pride we take in our homes
and communities. Whether you're planning your next project, helping customers create their dream
outdoor retreat, or exploring new building solutions, July is the perfect time to build with
confidence, creativity, and momentum. From concept to completion, we offer a mix of products to help
you create a truly unique space. Let's build better communities together!

[ Holiday Closure Announcements ][41]
[ Make-A-WIsh ][42]


Bringing Hope to Hearts 

A great big THANK YOU to everyone who supported, participated and donated this last weekend in our
Bringing Hope to Hearts annual Make-A-Wish fundraiser. Your generous contributions and donations are
expected to meet or exceed our 2026 goal of $50,000! Our Wishmaker community keeps getting larger
and we are so grateful to everyone for supporting J.M. Thomas and this cause.  

Thank you for your support!

# J.M. Thomas Forest Products

## Independent wholesale building materials Distributor

[ Our Products ][24]

## Welcome to J.M. Thomas Forest Products!

We are your experts in engineered wood, lumber, panels, siding, pre-finish, and specialty building
products interior and exterior. We understand the needs and trends of the building industry and work
through retail yards to successfully provide quality building materials to the markets we serve.  

[ Contact Us ][25]

## Founded in 1981 by J. Matthew Thomas

### Service, Quality, and Commitment are not just words, but a way of doing business.

[ About Us ][26]

Product Highlight

ADORN STONE
* ADORN Stone sets a new standard in sustainable building. Made from high strength concrete and
  recycled materials, it delivers the authentic look of natural stone with lasting durability.
* It's fastener-based installation eliminates mortar, reducing environmental impact while improving
  efficiency - making it an ideal choice for both contractors and DIYers.
* Mortarless installation means faster, cleaner installation with no mixing mortar or messy
  clean-up.
* The screw-fastened panel system is easy to install using common tools. No clips, wires or starter
  strip required simplifing the installation process and reduces labor and material costs.
* Provides long-lasting durability and resistance to every day exposure.
* Ideal for home exteriors, fireplaces, accent walls, outdoor kitchens, fireplaces, columns, and
  commercial projects.
* Suitable for year round installation and reliable performance in a number of climates.
* Limited Lifetime Warranty provides added confidence in the products long-term quality and
  performance.

## Company Updates & News

### July Industry Outlook - Building Momentum

July is the heart of the building season, bringing long days, busy jobsites, and plenty of
opportunities to transform homes and commercial spaces. From outdoor living areas and exterior
renovations to curb appeal upgrades, summer continues to be the ideal time for projects that make a
lasting impact. Homeowners remain focused on improving the homes they already love, driving strong
demand for remodeling projects, outdoor entertainment spaces, and durable, low-maintenance building
materials. Builders are also embracing innovative products that help save time on the jobsite, while
delivering high-quality results. This month is about making the most of the season. Outdoor living
spaces, kitchens, entryways, and accent walls are among the most popular projects as families
prepare to entertain guests and enjoy time outdoors. Fast-install systems and sustainable building
solutions continue to gain attention as builders look for ways to improve efficiency without
sacrificing style or performance. This July, we should all take the opportunity to celebrate
America's 250th year of freedom and Independence Day reminds us of the pride we take in our homes
and communities. Whether you're planning your next project, helping customers create their dream
outdoor retreat, or exploring new building solutions, July is the perfect time to build with
confidence, creativity, and momentum. From concept to completion, we offer a mix of products to help
you create a truly unique space. Let's build better communities together!

products, with your familiar products such as Plywood, LVL, MDF and chipboard board. These products
are widely used in the construction, decoration, packaging industry and vehicle or ship
manufacturing fields.

* [Two super cool modern treehouses built by Chip Wade of HGTV on a hillside with outdoor lights, a
  paved driveway, tennis courts, a garden, and trees, during twilight.]
  
  ## As seen on HGTV: Rental Retreat in the North Georgia Mountains
  
  [ Read Case Study → ][17]

### Trimjoist is the marriage of an open-web floor joist and a trimmable wood i-joist.

Manufactured 100% in the USA, TrimJoist’s patented, trimmable open-web floor joist system combines
the trimmability of an I-joist with the open-web flexibility today’s trades demand.

Trusted by architects, engineers, and builders for over 30 years, Trimjoist continues to move floor
framing forward with a system that delivers longer spans, greater jobsite flexibility, and
dependable strength in one streamlined product.

### Watch what makes our product different.

TrimJoist benefits everyone involved in the construction process — owners, developers, architects,
engineers, builders, contractors, framers and more.

### Features & Benefits
* #### Open-Web Design
  
  The TrimJoist system's open web design allows subcontractors to easily, practically and quickly
  run electrical work, duct work and plumbing throughout the flooring system of any building.
  Running mechanical systems through the trusses instead of below them gives architects more design
  flexibility.
* #### Trimmable Ends
  
  Because each TrimJoist is trimmable on-site, contractors can always achieve a custom fit without
  the risk and lead time from standard custom floor trusses.
* #### Extra Wide Flanges
  
  Each joist has a 3.5-inch-wide nailing flange on the top and bottom, virtually ensuring a
  non-squeak floor when properly installed. The extra-wide nailing surface provided by the TrimJoist
  makes for a superior installation and more satisfied owners.
* #### Built in the USA
  
  The TrimJoist floor system is manufactured entirely in the United States. This allows for us to
  employ those in our local community, achieve a higher standard of quality control and guarantee
  timely delivery.
  
  Trimjoist introduced the first trimmable floor joist system to the building industry and is the
  only corporation with a patent on a trimmable floor joist.
* #### Local Availability
  
  Since the TrimJoist is available from stock at any authorized dealer, there are no lead times. Any
  overage or underage can be handled by your building supplier — not a factory, which may impose a
  surcharge for an “extra” joist.
* #### In-House Design & Support Staff
  
  Trimjoist’s in-house engineering staff is always on hand to assist contractors, architects and
  building designers in plan conversion and design layout. They provide detailed floor-framing plans
  and precise material lists for each project, which ensures the joists are shipped and installed
  right the first time.
  
  Trimjoist’s full-time technical support team is always available for support during installation
  of Trimjoist products.

#### For over 30 years, We Have focused on building the best floor joist possible.

And that’s why **TrimJoist is the floor system builders, architects, and engineers ask for by
name.**

## A CASE STUDY ON SYSTEM FRAMING

**Haggett Hall: A 230,000 SF Student Housing Facility located in Seattle, WA using TrimJoist +
Freres Mass Ply + Tall Wall Framing Approach**

On large-scale multi-family projects, the building structure is no longer evaluated solely by spans
and loads. It’s evaluated on whether it can accommodate the growing complexities of modern building
systems: bigger ductwork driven by new energy codes, more dense plumbing and fire protection
systems, and tighter floor-to-floor height targets — all while providing safer work conditions for
all trades.

That was exactly the situation at Haggett Hall, a 230,000 square foot student housing project, on
the University of Washington's campus in Seattle.

[ Read the Haggett Hall Case Study ][18]

* [Two super cool modern treehouses built by Chip Wade of HGTV on a hillside with outdoor lights, a
  paved driveway, tennis courts, a garden, and trees, during twilight.]
  
  ## As seen on HGTV: Rental Retreat in the North Georgia Mountains
  
  [ Read Case Study → ][17]

### Trimjoist is the marriage of an open-web floor joist and a trimmable wood i-joist.

Manufactured 100% in the USA, TrimJoist’s patented, trimmable open-web floor joist system combines
the trimmability of an I-joist with the open-web flexibility today’s trades demand.

Trusted by architects, engineers, and builders for over 30 years, Trimjoist continues to move floor
framing forward with a system that delivers longer spans, greater jobsite flexibility, and
dependable strength in one streamlined product.

### Watch what makes our product different.

TrimJoist benefits everyone involved in the construction process — owners, developers, architects,
engineers, builders, contractors, framers and more.

### Features & Benefits
* #### Open-Web Design
  
  The TrimJoist system's open web design allows subcontractors to easily, practically and quickly
  run electrical work, duct work and plumbing throughout the flooring system of any building.
  Running mechanical systems through the trusses instead of below them gives architects more design
  flexibility.
* #### Trimmable Ends
  
  Because each TrimJoist is trimmable on-site, contractors can always achieve a custom fit without
  the risk and lead time from standard custom floor trusses.
* #### Extra Wide Flanges
  
  Each joist has a 3.5-inch-wide nailing flange on the top and bottom, virtually ensuring a
  non-squeak floor when properly installed. The extra-wide nailing surface provided by the TrimJoist
  makes for a superior installation and more satisfied owners.
* #### Built in the USA
  
  The TrimJoist floor system is manufactured entirely in the United States. This allows for us to
  employ those in our local community, achieve a higher standard of quality control and guarantee
  timely delivery.
  
  Trimjoist introduced the first trimmable floor joist system to the building industry and is the
  only corporation with a patent on a trimmable floor joist.
* #### Local Availability
  
  Since the TrimJoist is available from stock at any authorized dealer, there are no lead times. Any
  overage or underage can be handled by your building supplier — not a factory, which may impose a
  surcharge for an “extra” joist.
* #### In-House Design & Support Staff
  
  Trimjoist’s in-house engineering staff is always on hand to assist contractors, architects and
  building designers in plan conversion and design layout. They provide detailed floor-framing plans
  and precise material lists for each project, which ensures the joists are shipped and installed
  right the first time.
  
  Trimjoist’s full-time technical support team is always available for support during installation
  of Trimjoist products.

#### For over 30 years, We Have focused on building the best floor joist possible.

And that’s why **TrimJoist is the floor system builders, architects, and engineers ask for by
name.**

## A CASE STUDY ON SYSTEM FRAMING

**Haggett Hall: A 230,000 SF Student Housing Facility located in Seattle, WA using TrimJoist +
Freres Mass Ply + Tall Wall Framing Approach**

On large-scale multi-family projects, the building structure is no longer evaluated solely by spans
and loads. It’s evaluated on whether it can accommodate the growing complexities of modern building
systems: bigger ductwork driven by new energy codes, more dense plumbing and fire protection
systems, and tighter floor-to-floor height targets — all while providing safer work conditions for
all trades.

That was exactly the situation at Haggett Hall, a 230,000 square foot student housing project, on
the University of Washington's campus in Seattle.

# Sustainable engineered wood products that change the construction world.

VMG LIGNUM manufactures and supplies premium engineered wood products: LVL, I-JOIST, and STRUCTURAL
PARTICLE BOARD (P4-P7). We offer high-quality engineered wood products for residential, commercial,
and public construction projects, available for direct purchase from our well-stocked warehouse. Our
mission is to enhance construction companies' project flexibility and speed with a diverse range of
engineered wood products and services. VMG LIGNUM develops building systems with prefabricated
components for new construction projects as well as renovations using engineered wood products. VMG
LIGNUM also offers an extensive range of versatile building design, structural modeling, and
consulting services.

The July-August issue of Wood & Panel Europe highlights the latest advancements in engineered wood,
sustainable forestry, and precision cutting tools driving the future of the woodworking industry.
Featuring emerging technologies, market trends, and expert perspectives, this edition delivers
valuable insights into the evolving global wood and panel sector. Stay tuned!

**Cover Story (Engineered Wood):**

Engineered wood combines sustainability, strength, and design versatility for next-generation
construction and interior applications.

**Focus (Waste Recycling):**

Waste recycling is becoming a key driver of sustainability, transforming wood residues into valuable
resources.

**Special Feature (Wood Based Panel):**

Wood-based panels are driving sustainable, high-performance solutions for modern furniture,
construction, and interior applications.

[Local Government support for Modern Methods of Construction]
[Local Government support for Modern Methods of Construction][57]
July 13, 2026
Course Overview Learn how leading cities across BC are supporting the adoption of modern methods of
construction. This session will explore what policies and incentives cities have adopted to support
mass timber in the planning and development approval process, how building departments are revising
their permitting processes to support offsite and prefab construction, and how recent Official
Community Plan (OCP) amendments have included more land use categories to support mass timber in mid
and high rise applications. It will also examine how mass timber helps meet other City objectives,
from low carbon emission goals for new construction to rapid housing targets, and highlight new and
exciting projects in each of these cities that are in planning, under construction, or recently
completed using mass timber. Learning Objectives Identify municipal policies, incentives, and
planning tools that support the adoption of mass timber construction. Understand how permitting and
development approval processes are evolving to accommodate offsite, prefabricated, and mass timber
construction methods. Learn how Official Community Plans and land-use policies can create
opportunities for mass timber in mid- and high-rise development. Assess how mass timber construction
can help municipalities achieve broader objectives related to housing delivery, sustainability, and
emissions reduction. Course Video Speakers Bio Annabelle Hamilton Executive Director WoodWorks BC |
Canadian Wood Council Annabelle oversees WoodWorks BC, the market development program of the
Canadian Wood Council. After completing her postgraduate degree in Northern Ireland, she worked with
several multi-family development companies, managing multi-million-dollar projects across the full
lifecycle – from acquisitions and municipal approvals through to construction completion. She now
leads the WoodWorks BC team in advancing innovative solutions that support the adoption of wood
products in multi-family and non-residential projects across British Columbia. Scott Groves Director
Corporate Projects Township of Langley Scott Groves is the Director of Corporate Projects for the
Township of Langley, where he leads the planning, design, and delivery of major community buildings
and parks projects. An experienced civil engineer, he has spent his career in local government
advancing complex capital initiatives, including arenas, community centres, fire halls, civic
facilities, and large park and sports infrastructure that serve residents across the region. Before
joining the Township of Langley, Scott held senior roles with several Metro Vancouver
municipalities, directing capital projects, facilities, and strategic civic lands initiatives, and
contributing to Olympic‑related infrastructure and major transportation projects. He holds a
Bachelor of Applied Science in Civil Engineering from the University of British Columbia and is
known for his collaborative approach to community building and his commitment to delivering
high‑quality public spaces. Stacy McGhee Manager, Strategic Facilities Planning District of Saanich
Stacy McGhee is a registered architect in the province of British Columbia. His work experience
spans a wide range of building types, project sizes and procurements. Stacy’s work in both public
and private sectors has given him a unique perspective of consultant and owner viewpoints enabling
him to manage projects with a clearer mandate and sound contractual understanding. Stacy’s private
sector work includes luxury hotels, commercial offices, historic renovation and healthcare. Since
2009, Stacy’s public sector work includes six years with the Province of BC working with BC
Corrections to modernize facilities and to undertake large, multi-year P3 projects building $200M+
facilities

[Local Government support for Modern Methods of Construction][57]
July 13, 2026
Course Overview Learn how leading cities across BC are supporting the adoption of modern methods of
construction. This session will explore what policies and incentives cities have adopted to support
mass timber in the planning and development approval process, how building departments are revising
their permitting processes to support offsite and prefab construction, and how recent Official
Community Plan (OCP) amendments have included more land use categories to support mass timber in mid
and high rise applications. It will also examine how mass timber helps meet other City objectives,
from low carbon emission goals for new construction to rapid housing targets, and highlight new and
exciting projects in each of these cities that are in planning, under construction, or recently
completed using mass timber. Learning Objectives Identify municipal policies, incentives, and
planning tools that support the adoption of mass timber construction. Understand how permitting and
development approval processes are evolving to accommodate offsite, prefabricated, and mass timber
construction methods. Learn how Official Community Plans and land-use policies can create
opportunities for mass timber in mid- and high-rise development. Assess how mass timber construction
can help municipalities achieve broader objectives related to housing delivery, sustainability, and
emissions reduction. Course Video Speakers Bio Annabelle Hamilton Executive Director WoodWorks BC |
